tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人先物後：give 人 物，不填介系詞（×）。物先人後：give 物 to 人；buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: Why 的用法
tips.text: 問原因用 Why；be 動詞放主詞前，一般動詞用 do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

tips.label: Because 和 So
tips.text: because 後接原因；so 後接結果。同一組因果子句不要同時用 because 和 so。

tips.label: Because 和 Because of
tips.text: because + 主詞 + 動詞；because of + 名詞或名詞片語。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write、pass 的物在前時用 to；buy、make、cook 用 for。人直接放在動詞後、物放最後時，不加介系詞，題目以 × 表示不填。例如 Mom bought me × a coat；改成物在前則是 Mom bought a coat for me。人稱代名詞當受詞時用 me、him、her、us、them。本課物用 it／them 時，採「物＋to／for＋人」。
examples: Mom bought a coat for me.
The nurse gave Amy some medicine.
The nurse gave some medicine to Amy.

notes.title: Why 的用法
notes.rule: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞 ...?；Why + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: Why 問原因。問狀態時將 be 動詞放主詞前；問一般動詞的動作時用 do、does 或 did。did／did not 後面的動詞都用原形。回答可用 Because + 原因子句。
examples: Why does Tom wear a mask every day?
Why did you call the doctor?
Why didn't Amy take her medicine?

notes.title: Because 和 So 的因果順序
notes.rule: 結果 + because + 原因；Because + 原因, 結果；原因, so + 結果
notes.description: because 帶出原因，so 帶出結果。because 子句放句首時，後面用逗號分開。同一組因果子句不寫成 Because ..., so ...。
examples: I stayed home because I had a fever.
Because I had a fever, I stayed home.
I had a fever, so I stayed home.

notes.title: Because 和 Because of 的差別
notes.rule: because + 子句；because of + 名詞／名詞片語
notes.description: 先看後面有沒有主詞與動詞。he was sick 是完整子句，用 because；his illness 是名詞片語，用 because of。不能只看中文都譯為「因為」就混用。
examples: Tom missed school because he had a fever.
Tom missed school because of his fever.
Because the weather was bad, we stayed home.
Because of the bad weather, we stayed home.

quiz.question: Grandma bought us ___ warm coats for winter.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: buy＋人＋物；us 是人，warm coats 是物，兩者之間不用介系詞。

quiz.question: The doctor gave Amy ___ some medicine.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: give＋人＋物；Amy 在前、medicine 在後，不填介系詞。

quiz.question: Dad made the children ___ hot soup.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: make＋人＋物；the children 後直接接 hot soup。

quiz.question: Our teacher showed me ___ a picture of the human body.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: show＋人＋物；me 是人、a picture 是物，不填介系詞。

quiz.question: This medicine is for Amy. Please give it ___ her.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: give＋物＋to＋人；it 指藥，her 指收藥的人。

quiz.question: The message is for Dad. Please send it ___ him.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: send＋物＋to＋人；it 是訊息，him 是收件人。

quiz.question: The doctor needs your health report. Show it ___ her.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: show＋物＋to＋人，表示把報告給醫生看。

quiz.question: Mom bought this coat ___ me because my old one was too small.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: buy＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人買東西。

quiz.question: The baby was hungry, so Dad made some food ___ him.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: make＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人製作食物。

quiz.question: Grandpa was sick, so we cooked some soup ___ him.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: cook＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人煮食物。

quiz.question: The nurse gave ___ a clean mask.
quiz.hint: give＋人＋物中的人是受詞，第一人稱用 me。

quiz.question: My aunt bought ___ some new clothes.
quiz.hint: buy 後接受格 us，表示買衣服給我們。

quiz.question: The doctor showed ___ a picture of a healthy heart.
quiz.hint: show 後的人是受詞，要用受格 them。

quiz.question: These masks are for Ben. Please give ___ to him.
quiz.hint: 空格代替複數 masks，作 give 的受詞，用 them。

quiz.question: This coat is for my sister. Mom bought it for ___.
quiz.hint: for 後用受格 her，指 my sister；此處不是媽媽為自己買。

quiz.question: This is your medicine. I will give ___ to you after lunch.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 medicine，作 give 的受詞，用 it。

quiz.question: ___ did Amy stay home? Because she had a fever.
quiz.hint: 回答提供原因，因此用 Why 詢問。

quiz.question: Why ___ your hands so cold right now?
quiz.hint: hands 是複數，cold 是形容詞，right now 用現在式 are。

quiz.question: Why ___ your brother absent yesterday?
quiz.hint: absent 描述狀態；yesterday 用過去式，單數 brother 搭配 was。

quiz.question: Why ___ the children so quiet last night?
quiz.hint: children 是複數，quiet 描述狀態，last night 搭配 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ your father take this medicine every day?
quiz.hint: every day 表示習慣，your father 是第三人稱單數，一般動詞問句用 does。

quiz.question: Why ___ you call the doctor last night?
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去；call 是一般動詞，問句用 did。

quiz.question: Why does your sister ___ her neck so often?
quiz.hint: does 後用原形 touch，不再加 es。

quiz.question: Why did the nurse ___ your mother a message?
quiz.hint: did 後接原形 send，不用過去式 sent。

quiz.question: Why didn't Ben ___ his medicine yesterday?
quiz.hint: didn't 後用原形 take。

quiz.question: Why do the students ___ masks at school?
quiz.hint: do 後的主要動詞用原形 wear。

quiz.question: Why ___ your head so hot now?
quiz.hint: head 是單數，hot 是形容詞，now 用 is。

quiz.question: Why ___ they exercise every morning?
quiz.hint: every morning 表示習慣，主詞 they 的一般動詞問句用 do。

quiz.question: Why didn't your uncle ___ home after work?
quiz.hint: didn't 後用原形 go，不用 went。

quiz.question: A: Why were you late? B: ___ I missed the bus.
quiz.hint: Why 問原因；I missed the bus 是完整原因子句，前面用 Because。

quiz.question: ___ my knee hurt, I couldn't run.
quiz.hint: my knee hurt 是原因子句；放在句首用 Because 引出，後接結果。

quiz.question: It was cold, ___ I put on my coat.
quiz.hint: 天冷導致穿外套，結果前用 so；therefore 不能只靠逗號連接兩個完整子句。

quiz.question: Because the baby was hungry, ___ Mom fed him.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: Because 已引出原因，後面的結果子句直接接續，不再加 so。

quiz.question: I couldn't carry the box because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接主詞與動詞，my arm hurt 是完整原因子句。

quiz.question: ___ the medicine tasted bad, the child didn't want to take it.
quiz.hint: 藥難吃是原因；完整原因子句前用 Because。

quiz.question: Grandma couldn't hear me, ___ I spoke more loudly.
quiz.hint: 聽不見導致說得更大聲，用 so 連接結果；therefore 不能直接以逗號連接兩個完整子句。

quiz.question: Because the children were sick, ___ they missed the trip.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 同一組因果子句已用 Because，結果子句前不再加 so。

quiz.question: ___ the room was dark, Dad turned on the light.
quiz.hint: the room was dark 是完整原因子句，前面用 Because。

quiz.question: Because my throat hurt, ___ I rested my voice.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: Because 已連接原因與結果，不再加入 so。

quiz.question: The soup was too hot, ___ I waited for it to cool.
quiz.hint: 湯太燙是原因，等湯變涼是結果，用 so；therefore 不能只用逗號連接兩個完整子句。

quiz.question: The team missed the game because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the heavy snow，其他選項都是子句。

quiz.question: Amy went to bed early because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接主詞與動詞，she felt sick 是完整子句。

quiz.question: We stayed inside because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: Tom couldn't eat because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後需要完整子句，his tooth hurt 有主詞和動詞。

quiz.question: The singer rested because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 her sore throat。

quiz.question: Dad called the doctor because ___.
options: B. of the baby was sick
D. the baby had a fever
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句 the baby had a fever。

quiz.question: ___ his headache, Ben couldn't finish his homework.
quiz.hint: his headache 是名詞片語，原因前用 Because of。

quiz.question: ___ her knee hurt, Sue couldn't climb the stairs.
quiz.hint: her knee hurt 是完整原因子句，前面用 Because。

quiz.question: The road was closed because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the heavy rain。

quiz.question: We called a taxi because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句，Grandpa couldn't walk far 有主詞與動詞。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為寶寶生病了，我們待在家裡。

grammar.sentence: Dad cooked some noodles for the hungry children.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸煮了一些麵給飢餓的孩子們。

grammar.sentence: Why does your brother wear a mask?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你哥哥為什麼戴口罩？

grammar.sentence: The player rested because of his sore knee.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那名球員因為膝蓋痠痛而休息。

grammar.sentence: Grandma made us some soup for lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 奶奶煮了一些湯給我們當午餐。

grammar.sentence: The room was dark, so I turned on the light.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 房間很暗，所以我開了燈。

grammar.sentence: Why didn't Amy take her medicine yesterday?
grammar.sentence_chinese: Amy 昨天為什麼沒有吃藥？

grammar.sentence: Please give the clean mask to your sister.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把乾淨的口罩交給你妹妹。

grammar.sentence: I couldn't sleep because my head hurt.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我因為頭痛而睡不著。

grammar.sentence: My uncle sent me a message last night.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我叔叔昨晚傳了一則訊息給我。

grammar.sentence: Why were the children absent from school yesterday?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們昨天為什麼沒來上學？

grammar.sentence: The game ended early because of the strong wind.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 比賽因為強風而提早結束。

grammar.sentence: Please pass the medicine to your father.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把藥遞給你爸爸。

grammar.sentence: Because her throat hurt, she couldn't speak clearly.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為她喉嚨痛，她無法說清楚。

grammar.sentence: Why do you exercise before breakfast every day?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你為什麼每天早餐前運動？

grammar.sentence: My aunt bought the children some new clothes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我阿姨買了一些新衣服給孩子們。

grammar.sentence: The singer canceled the show because of her illness.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位歌手因病取消了演出。

grammar.sentence: Please send this message to the school nurse.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把這則訊息傳給學校護士。

grammar.sentence: Why was your brother at the hospital yesterday?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你哥哥昨天為什麼在醫院？

grammar.sentence: The road was closed because of the heavy snow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 道路因為大雪而封閉。

grammar.sentence: Why did the doctor check your eyes?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 醫生為什麼檢查你的眼睛？

grammar.sentence: Tom stayed home because he had a fever.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Tom 因為發燒而待在家裡。

grammar.sentence: Grandpa missed the trip because of his headache.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爺爺因為頭痛而錯過了旅行。
